changelog:
Center the Cup menu and open it for joined players when the organizer creates Cup mode; keep personal panel toggles local.
Automatically hide menus during track loading, warmup and race starts.
Format finish, WR, TR and PB times as minutes:seconds.milliseconds; retain compact relative gaps.
Replace dotted provisional-point borders with subdued badges and inset the slanted time cells.
End Cup for everyone restores driving and POV camera state; periodic empty-state sync recovers missed end messages and rejects stale updates.
